summary: Abacus Global Management filed an 8-K reporting a First Amendment to its existing Credit Agreement. The amendment adds $75 million in incremental term loans, raising total facility principal to $225 million. Maturity remains December 10, 2030, with quarterly amortization and interest based on adjusted term SOFR plus 5.25% (stepdown to 5.00% upon achieving EBIT metrics). Lenders and agents are unchanged. This is a routine debt-financing amendment, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, or strategic event is triggered. The filing discloses no deal terms beyond the loan amount and rate.
